assets.initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Refine the APPROVED Pointer Cursor Family composition, not a redesign. Output one edge-to-edge, front-on desktop interface at 1536 x 1024. Reference 1 is the edit target and carries the approved region topology, Chinese type, Apple system / Liquid Glass material quality and Pointer identity. Reference 2 is ONLY the exact code-rendered cursor family silhouettes and black-white contrast; never copy its row grid layout.
LOCKED structure: compact title and brand top-left; top-center four-item navigation; status and one blue Apply action top-right with separate Windows minus/square/close caption; dominant selected cursor at upper middle-left; four smaller role specimens on a shallow ordered fan below; paired-background preview at upper-right; broad shared appearance shelf lower-left; compact preview/appearance inspector lower-right. Do not move these into columns or reinvent the layout. Preserve the broad canonical rounded three-tip arrow, actual hand finger/palm silhouette, I-beam, loading ring and 4-way movement from reference 2. Roles are flat precise 2D specimens, never 3D, shadowed, glowing or haloed. Light background = black body white outline. Dark background = white body black outline. No Apple logos or macOS traffic lights.
Craft refinements: optically normalize small family specimens so none feels excessively heavy or mismatched; the selected specimen stays about 3x their scale. Retain calm shallow fan and concise labels 手形 / 输入 / 加载 / 移动. Selected role label 箭头 uses a small elegant pill with a check, less oversized than current bright circular mark. One coherent icon family, exact baselines, deliberate 4/8/12/16/24/32 spacing rhythm. Pearl #F6F6F8, ink #202126, graphite #25262B, restrained #0064D8 interactive accent, subtle glass rim and soft downward shadow. Reduce redundant card borders and nested control boxes. Windows installed Chinese/system UI font character; clear regular labels, no tiny paragraphs. The interface must remain usable and readable, no ornamental decoration or fake performance claims.
Global shape shelf: heading 统一外观; 4 shape specimens 圆润 selected / 精准 / 锐角 / 像素, with a pale blue 12px selection tile ONLY around the selected item; unselected specimens share open surface with no card outlines. Size control to its right: 大小, slider, value 32 px, choices 24 32 40 48 64. Color and sizes affect the whole theme.
Separate preview mode from actual system adaptation: place a compact observation selector just above right background specimen, labelled 预览背景 with choices 浅色 / 深色 / 对比; 对比 is visibly selected since paired backgrounds are displayed. This selector is absent from lower inspector, no duplicated control.
Lower-right inspector: role heading 箭头预览; a small actual-size specimen beside value 32 px and label 实际大小; independent row 背景适配 with 自动 selected / 浅色 / 深色; row 配色 with paired black-white swatches, label 黑白 and a disclosure; final 更多选项 disclosure. It fits naturally in same lower-right zone. Do not invent per-role appearance settings. Selecting role only changes the preview.
At top left subtitle shorten to 选择角色，预览整套光标. Add a small 全部角色 entry near role stage (no invented count). Top right status is 草稿 · 未应用, without a fake button called 草稿预览; one stable primary 应用更改. No state claims or added features. This is an unimplemented refinement mockup, not a working application or actual-size calibration.
LIGHT refinement state: keep full interface light pearl and white surfaces. Main selected arrow is BLACK body WHITE outline on pearl. Right graphite comparison tile labelled 深色背景 has a WHITE body BLACK outline arrow. Supporting roles on pearl use black body white outline. Preserve clean optically balanced frame and subtle material differentiation. Selected arrow is the focus, not the navigation. Same approved Cursor Family layout.
